label: GO step choosing a2, last ~8 trials of the episode (end-of-episode clock)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only late in the episode: 99.8% of activation mass is in episode trials 90-99, with none before trial 80, and all of it is where the value head is in its lowest bin (<5.22), since value drops as the episode nears its end. About 98% of mass is on GO steps where the model picks a2 (model_act==2, strongly negative choice logit). It almost never fires on a1 choices, D1, or D2. Magnitude climbs steadily trial by trial toward the end of the episode, as seen in the top windows where activation rises across consecutive trials and peaks around trial 98-99. Reward, transition, and stay/switch history barely modulate it. The exact onset trial is soft, which limits precision. Small extra: d1_err trials (in_rew=-1 at GO) have a high rate but are a tiny share of mass. Recorded predicate is (phase==GO)&(ep_trial>=93)&(model_act==2) (dev F1 0.81, test F1 0.77, mass recall 0.94). Using ep_trial>=90 gets more recall (mass 0.98) but precision only 0.55. No future variables are used: the agent can infer elapsed time, and model_act is its own choice.
